title: Knockturn Alley Book Nook
desc: There is a lot to discover in this tiny alley, from the glowing shop windows to the stairways tucked between the buildings.

title: A Peek Inside the Book Nook
desc: From this angle, the alley seems to stretch much farther into the distance than you would expect from a book nook.

title: Down the Cobblestone Alley
desc: Follow the glow of the streetlamps down the cobblestone alley. There are little details to discover all along the way.

title: The Alley After Dark
desc: The alley takes on a different look after dark, with blue, green, and purple light glowing through the windows.

title: The Diagon Alley Entrance
desc: An arched passage marked by a tiny Diagon Alley sign sits among brick walls and shop windows. Look closely for the Mail Owl flying toward you!

title: Borgin and Burkes
desc: Take a closer look at Borgin and Burkes. The curved shop windows, hanging sign, and weathered doors give it plenty of character.

title: Cauldrons Outside the Shop
desc: The stacked cauldrons are easy to spot, but take a look through the windows of Borgin and Burkes, too.

title: Skulls in the Window
desc: Look closely at the lighted windowpanes to spot the skulls peering out from behind the glass.

title: Bones, Barrels, and Broomsticks
desc: A barrel of bones, a bundle of broomsticks, and Hermione near the doorway fill this corner of the alley.

title: The Skeleton by the Stairs
desc: A skeleton has found a seat on a crate beneath the stairs. The glowing red window makes this corner even spookier.

title: The Hidden Staircase
desc: Tiny doors, winding stairs, and Ron Weasley on the landing add another layer of detail above the alley.

title: The Daily Prophet Sign
desc: There is even a tiny Daily Prophet sign hanging beside the bright blue window.

title: A Glowing Streetlamp
desc: Even the little streetlamp has its own character. Its warm light brings out the texture of the weathered wood.

title: Colorful Windows and a Winding Pipe
desc: Did you spot the winding pipe? It snakes up the brick wall beside the tall, green-lit window.

title: A Glimpse Down the Passage
desc: This close-up makes the alley feel as though it goes on forever. The soft focus adds to the mysterious atmosphere.

title: Building the Wooden Facade
desc: Here is one of the building fronts before it became part of the alley. You can see the weathered siding, tiny doors, and window frames up close.

title: Building the Brick Wall
desc: Here is the brick wall before it was added to the scene. It is easier to appreciate the textured brickwork and winding pipe in this view.
